standing.general: Hinge at hips, soft knees, chest at 45 degrees, neutral spine.
standing.ballContact: Pound the ball down; do not slap with loose fingers.

seated.general: Sit on the front edge of a chair, tall neutral spine, zero back load.
seated.ballContact: Pure wrist and forearm snap; isolate arm mechanics.

drills.name: Fingertip Ball Taps
drills.description:
• How to do it: Extend your arms straight out in front of your chest. Rapidly bounce/tap the ball back and forth between the fingertips of both hands without letting it touch your palms. Move arms slowly from eye level down to waist level and back up.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Eyes: Look straight ahead over the ball; do not look down at your hands.
  - Form: Keep elbows soft, not hyperextended.
• Mistake to avoid: Don't catch or slap the ball with your palm pads; this is pure fingertip reflex.

drills.name: Around-the-Body Wraps
drills.description:
• How to do it: Plant feet shoulder-width apart. Pass the ball hand-to-hand in continuous circles around your waist, then drop into a flat-back hip hinge for knee circles, and stand tall for head circles. Reverse direction halfway through.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Eyes: Keep eyes fixed at eye level on a wall point or screen.
  - Movement: Keep your torso and hips quiet; do not swing your torso or sway side-to-side.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not rest the ball against your body or clothes as you pass it behind your back.

drills.name: Left-Hand Ankle Pounding
drills.description:
• How to do it: Drop into an athletic hinge—push hips backward, bend knees, keep collarbones up at 45 degrees. Pound the ball with your left hand at shoe/ankle level using rapid wrist and forearm snaps.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Keep bounce height strictly below 25 cm (shoe-collar height).
  - Eyes: Fix your gaze straight ahead; look at the ball only for the first 5 seconds to calibrate bounce.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not round your lower spine forward to reach the floor. Lower your hand by bending knees and flexing wrists, not bending at the waist.

drills.name: Left-Hand Side Pocket Pounds
drills.description:
• How to do it: Stay in the hip hinge. Dribble the ball along the outer edge of your left foot/heel. Push the ball forward toward the toes and pull it back behind the heel in a straight track.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Keep the travel path under 40 cm length; never let the ball drift across your body.
  - Hand contact: Keep your hand on the top-rear quadrant to push forward, and top-front quadrant to pull back.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not scoop or turn your palm upward under the ball at either turnaround point (carrying violation).

drills.name: High-to-Low Accordion (Right)
drills.description:
• How to do it: Stand with knees soft. Pound 3 times hard at shoulder/armpit height, then drop your hips into a deep hinge and deliver 3 micro-pounds at ankle level. Alternate continuously.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: High dribble stays capped at shoulder level; low dribble stays below knee level.
  - Eyes: Maintain horizontal eye level throughout the entire height transition.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not let the ball float or wait for it to bounce back; smash the foam ball down into the floor on high pounds.

drills.name: High-to-Low Accordion (Left)
drills.description:
• How to do it: Repeat the high-to-low cycle using only your off-hand. Focus on driving downward force through the left palm pad and triceps on the high dribbles.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Ball must rebound in a tight vertical cylinder directly outside your left hip.
  - Eyes: Keep your chin up and eyes on the horizon.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not let the weak hand drift inward toward your centerline on the high bounce.

drills.name: Tight V-Dribble (Front)
drills.description:
• How to do it: From an athletic stance, push and pull the ball in an inverted "V" shape across your midline with one hand, moving it back and forth like a windshield wiper. Switch hands halfway.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Never exceed 60 cm width (stay strictly within shoulder width). Bounce height must stay below the knee.
  - Eyes: Lock eyes forward; rely on fingertip sensation to detect the ball's apex.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not slap the ball back and forth; your hand must ride the outside curve of the ball and push-roll it across.

drills.name: 2-Pound + Crossover
drills.description:
• How to do it: Pound twice hard with your right hand outside your right knee, then execute a crisp cross to the left hand. Pound twice with the left hand, then cross back to the right.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Total crossover width must stay under 1 meter. The crossover bounce must land dead center between your feet below knee height.
  - Eyes: Fix gaze forward; do not watch the ball cross your body.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not let your off-hand reach forward across your body to grab the ball early. Let the ball travel all the way to the receiving pocket.

drills.name: Crossover with Shift
drills.description:
• How to do it: Continuous low crossovers side-to-side. As the ball crosses left, load your weight into your left foot instep. As it crosses right, transfer weight into the right instep.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Keep your feet completely inside the 2.5 m² footprint; do not travel or jump laterally.
  - Height: Keep the ball bounce below mid-shin level.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not lean your upper torso off-balance. Shift only your hips and weight while keeping your spine neutral and head stable.

drills.name: Off-Hand Wall-Tap Isolation
drills.description:
• How to do it: Maintain a continuous, low, stationary dribble with your active hand while your non-dribbling hand reaches forward and taps the wall rhythmically at chest height. Switch hands halfway.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Dribble must stay within a 30 cm radius beside your foot.
  - Eyes: Look straight at the spot you are tapping on the wall, not down at the dribble.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not pause your dribble rhythm when your tapping hand makes contact with the wall.

drills.name: Left-Hand Ankle Pounds
drills.description:
• How to do it: Warm up the weak hand at shoe height with rapid, compact pounds.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Maximum 20 cm bounce height.
  - Eyes: Do not look down; look straight ahead at your wall target.
• Mistake to avoid: Don't let your chest drop forward onto your knees as you fatigue.

drills.name: Left-Hand Side Pocket
drills.description:
• How to do it: Linear push-pull alongside your left shoe heel.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Keep forward-backward travel strictly within 40 cm.
  - Eyes: Eyes up at 90 degrees to the wall or screen.
• Mistake to avoid: No upward palm turn at either turnaround.

drills.name: Low Rapid V-Crossovers
drills.description:
• How to do it: Non-stop alternating crossovers in front of the body with zero setup pounds in between.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Width strictly between 60 cm and 80 cm. Height strictly below the kneecaps.
  - Eyes: Eyes up off the floor entirely.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not let the ball float upward. Push each bounce down aggressively so the ball hits the floor instantly.

drills.name: 1-Pound Rapid Cross
drills.description:
• How to do it: One hard pound with the right hand, cross to left; one hard pound with the left hand, cross to right.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Width capped at 1 meter. Both pounds and crosses must hit identical return heights.
  - Eyes: Fix eyes forward on the screen or wall.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not make the left-hand pound softer or slower than the right-hand pound.

drills.name: Continuous Rhythmic Crossovers
drills.description:
• How to do it: Continuous uninterrupted crossing while watching your iPad, movie, or TV screen.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Crossover width must stay within 80 cm.
  - Eyes: 100% visual focus on the screen/content. If you have to look down at the ball, immediately slow your crossover tempo until your hands regain feel.
• Mistake to avoid: Don't let the ball drift forward into the room; keep the floor bounce point on the line between your big toes.

drills.name: Accordion Dribbles (Alternating)
drills.description:
• How to do it: Continuous alternating dribbles while shifting smoothly between high pounds (shoulder level) and ankle-height micro-pounds.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: High dribble capped at shoulder level; low dribble capped at ankle level.
  - Eyes: Keep eyes on the screen; track the ball purely through arm extension feel.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not stand completely upright on high dribbles—keep a slight knee bend at all times.

drills.name: Figure-8 Dribbles
drills.description:
• How to do it: Hinge deeply at the hips and weave the ball continuously in a figure-8 path around and between both legs.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: The ball must stay entirely within your stance width (feet shoulder-width apart, ~50–60 cm).
  - Eyes: Keep your chin up and eyes pointed forward; do not look down through your legs.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not curve or hunch your lumbar spine. If your lower back tires, pause for 5 seconds, reset your hips, and resume.

drills.name: Free Flow / Freestyle
drills.description:
• How to do it: String together crossovers, pocket pulls, V-dribbles, and height variations at your own rhythm.
• Constraints & Guardrails:
  - Boundaries: Stay inside your 2.5 m² area; keep all crossovers and moves under 1 meter total width.
  - Eyes: Full eyes-up screen/distraction mode.
• Mistake to avoid: Do not repeat only your favorite right-hand move. Force an alternating sequence (every right-hand move must be mirrored or followed by a left-hand counter).
